description: Awarding the Contract for Ground Handling Services of Sri Lankan Airlines at the Sydney Airport in Australia
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Contract for Ground Handling Services of Sri Lankan Airlines at the Sydney Airport, Australia has expired on 2026-04-30. Therefore, bids have been invited under the limited International Competitive Procurement Procedure to select a contractor for supplying the said service. 03 bids have been received for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Ports and Civil Aviation to award the said Contract to Menzies Aviation (Australia) Pty Ltd., the substantially responsive lowest bidder for a sum of AUD 8.32 million based on the recommendation submitted by the Standing High Level Procurement Committee after evaluating the said bids, was approved by the Cabinet.
